{{Current events|year=2024|month=11|day=26|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***[[2024 Israel–Lebanon ceasefire agreement]]
****The [[Security Cabinet of Israel]] agrees to a 60-day [[ceasefire]] in [[Lebanon]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/world/live-news/israel-hezbollah-ceasefire-deal-gaza-war-11-26-24-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/biden-to-soon-give-white-house-address-thats-expected-to-address-israel-hezbollah-truce/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
****[[President of the United States|U.S President]] [[Joe Biden]] announces that the ceasefire has been accepted. [https://www.cnbc.com/2024/11/26/israel-lebanon-permanent-ceasefire-has-been-accepted-biden-says-.html (CNBC)]
***For the first time since the start of the conflict, the [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] issues [[Emergency evacuation|evacuation]] orders for central [[Beirut]], warning residents of four neighbourhoods to leave as soon as possible. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/in-first-idf-issues-evacuation-warnings-for-buildings-in-central-beirut/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[Airstrike]]s are carried out by the [[Israeli Air Force]] across several areas of [[Beirut]], Lebanon, hitting at least 20 locations and resulting in several casualties. [https://www.euronews.com/2024/11/26/israeli-airstrikes-hit-20-sites-in-lebanon-as-ceasefire-talks-with-hezbollah-show-signs-of (''Euronews'')] 
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern front of the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Kurakhove]]
****[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] enter the city of [[Kurakhove]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], with heavy fighting reportedly underway. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/11/26/russia-advances-in-ukraine-at-rapid-pace-moving-into-kurakhove-analysts- (Al Arabiya)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Puntland–Somaliland dispute]]
***[[Las Anod conflict (2023–present)|Las Anod conflict]]
****[[Somaliland]] imposes a curfew following a clash between [[Somaliland Armed Forces|soldiers]] and civilians that resulted in nine deaths and many injuries in [[Erigavo]], [[Sanaag]], Somaliland. [https://www.idilnews.com/sanaag-clashes-in-erigavo-leave-nine-dead-and-several-injured/ (''Idil News'')] [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2024/Nov/199080/somaliland_imposes_curfew_in_erigavo_after_deadly_clashes.aspx (Hiiraan Online)] [https://horseedmedia.net/violence-erupts-in-erigavo-somaliland-curfew-imposed-396049 (Horseed Media)]
*[[Arrest of Imran Khan]]
**Six people, including four paramilitary soldiers, are killed in clashes between security forces and supporters of former [[Prime Minister of Pakistan|Pakistani Prime Minister]] [[Imran Khan]] in [[Islamabad]]. The protesters, led by Khan's [[Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf]] party, are calling for Khan's immediate release from prison. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/four-paramilitary-troops-killed-attacks-pakistan-capital-interior-ministry-says-2024-11-26/ (Reuters)]
*Unidentified gunmen [[ambush]] a group of [[motorcycle taxi]]s returning from a religious ceremony in [[Bria, Central African Republic|Bria]], [[Haute-Kotto]], [[Central African Republic]], killing 10 people. [https://apnews.com/article/central-african-republic-mining-wagner-cpc-42bf3508ecbda1435c9bb4270a53d179 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–present United Kingdom cost-of-living crisis]]
**[[Multinational corporation|Multinational]] [[Automotive industry|car manufacturing company]] [[Stellantis]] announces that it will close its [[van]]-production factory in [[Luton]], [[England]], putting 1,100 jobs at risk, citing the [[United Kingdom|UK]]'s economic conditions and the government's zero-emission vehicle (ZEV) mandate as reasons for its closure. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2024/nov/26/vauxhall-owner-plans-to-shut-luton-van-factory-putting-1100-jobs-at-risk (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Red Sea tourist boat disaster]]
**Four people are found dead and five others are rescued from a tourist boat that sank yesterday off the coast of [[Marsa Alam]], [[Red Sea Governorate]], [[Egypt]]. Seven others are still missing. [https://amp.theguardian.com/world/2024/nov/26/bodies-recovered-from-capsized-tourist-boat-in-red-sea (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Winter of 2024–25 in the Gaza Strip]]
**A [[winter storm]] floods [[refugee camps]] across the [[Gaza Strip]], leading to several thousands of [[Refugee shelter|shelters]] being damaged or destroyed, and worsening refugee exposure to cold and illness. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/rainstorms-flood-tents-gazas-displaced-israel-steps-up-strikes-2024-11-25/ (Reuters)]
*Five people are killed and 20 others are reported missing when a [[motorboat]] capsizes in [[Warri]], [[Delta State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigeria-boat-accident-leaves-five-dead-20-missing-2024-11-26/ (Reuters)]
*Five people are killed and another is in critical condition when a [[Cessna 206 Stationair]] aircraft crashes into the Pico Blanco mountain near [[San José, Costa Rica|San José]], [[Costa Rica]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/costa-rica-plane-crash-kills-5/a-70884491 (DW)] [https://ticotimes.net/2024/11/26/five-dead-in-costa-rica-plane-crash-at-pico-blanco (''The Tico Times'')] 

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Censorship in Iraq]]
**The [[Iraq]]i [[Ministry of Communications (Iraq)|Ministry of Communications]] blocks access to the [[IMDb]] website, citing concerns of "immoral content". [https://www.intellinews.com/iraq-blocks-imdb-website-over-immoral-content-claims-355113/ (Intellinews)] [https://shafaq.com/en/Iraq/Iraq-blocks-IMDb-for-promoting-offensive-content-including-pornographic-films (Shafaq News)]
*[[LGBT rights in Hong Kong]]
**[[Chief justice]] [[Andrew Cheung]] of the [[Hong Kong]] [[Hong Kong Court of Final Appeal|Court of Final Appeal]] rules to uphold [[right to housing|housing]] and [[inheritance]] rights for [[same-sex couples]] in the city. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/26/hong-kongs-top-court-rules-in-favour-of-same-sex-couple-rights (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The [[Bangladesh Police]] fire [[tear gas]] at more than 2,000 [[Hinduism in Bangladesh|Hindus]] protesting in [[Chittagong]], [[Bangladesh]], against the arrest of [[Chinmoy Krishna Das]], a Hindu leader and [[International Society for Krishna Consciousness|ISKCON]] monk, on [[sedition]] charges. One is killed, and 27 are injured. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/krishna-das-prabhu-hindu-leader-and-iskcon-monk-arrested-in-bangladesh-who-is-he-101732543091203.html (''Hindustan Times'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/26/bangladesh-police-clash-with-protesters-as-hindu-leader-detained (Al Jazeera)] [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/south-asia/1-killed-27-injured-as-bangladesh-police-use-teargas-to-disperse-hindu-protesters-after-priest-chinmoy-krishna-das-arrest/articleshow/115701407.cms (''The Times of India'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Japanese space program]]
**[[JAXA]] aborts an [[Epsilon (rocket)|Epsilon S]] engine test after a fire occurs at the [[Tanegashima Space Center]] in [[Kagoshima Prefecture]], [[Japan]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/japan-space-agency-aborts-epsilon-s-rocket-test-after-fire/a-70884908 (DW)] [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/japan-tanegashima-space-center-rocket-engine-testing-halted-fire-4770551 (CNA)]
*Social media platform [[Bluesky]] says it will comply with rules set by the [[European Union]] after being accused of violating [[Regulation (European Union)|digital regulations]] under the [[Digital Services Act]]. [https://www.luxtimes.lu/businessandfinance/bluesky-says-it-will-comply-with-eu-rules-after-being-called-out/27723588.html (''Luxemburg Times'')] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-11-26/bluesky-says-it-will-comply-with-eu-rules-after-being-called-out (''Bloomberg'')]
